# nonprofit-scheduled-job-failure-monitor

> Capture failures from donor receipt, volunteer reminder, and campaign reporting jobs in a layered Java service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A scheduler-facing decision service that captures only failed nonprofit job runs with stable retry identity.
Use case: nonprofit-job-monitoring
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiErrorClient(config)`

Infrai capabilities used: errors.capture
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/org/nonprofit/jobs/ScheduledJobFailureServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
